The root cause of the repeated error is that the f-string in the `print` statement contains an unescaped newline, which breaks the string literal. This happens when using f-strings across multiple lines without proper escaping or using a multiline string.

I will fix the code by using a regular string with `.format()` instead of an f-string for multi-line output.

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for assay_batch unit issue
print('Unique assay_batch values: {}'.format(df["assay_batch"].unique()))

# Check arm and severity distribution
print('Arm distribution:
{}'.format(df["arm"].value_counts()))
print('Severity distribution:

# Check if any patient has multiple sample_seq
